info.cls_ename: Department of Mechanical and Computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 利用電腦輔助軟體來建模及分析，藉由課程之上課講解及互動學習，搭配實際上機操作以及作業、期末專題計畫等方式以熟悉：1) 電腦輔助工程軟體-數值模擬軟體的基本建模步驟；2) 數值模擬軟體的基本組裝及機構模擬方法；3) 數值模擬軟體基本模擬流程。學習使用電腦輔助設計軟體與分析。
description.describe_eh: Use computer-assisted software to model and analyze, through the introduction of the course and interactive learning, with actual machine operation and homework, final project planning, etc. with: 1) Computer-aided engineering software-the basic construction of numerical simulation Model steps; 2) Numerical simulation basic assembly and mechanism simulation method; 3) Numerical simulation basic simulation process establishment method. Learn to use computer-aided design software and analysis.
